scope: CVG-002B2B bounded SIGKILL recovery at every internal B1 checkpoint

criteria.description: Every declared internal B1 checkpoint pauses a real worker process and recovers through the takeover worker.
criteria.limitations: The matrix uses a local disposable PostgreSQL cluster and an explicitly synthetic provider.

criteria.description: SIGKILL during each internal B1 point leaves no partial receipt or financial settlement before lease takeover.
criteria.limitations: The assertions cover the declared local B1 state graph, not all possible database or process faults.

criteria.description: After lease expiry, a second real worker takes over and applies exactly one settlement with attempts=2 and lease_version=2.
criteria.limitations: This is one delivery/account and does not certify distributed clock, Redis or target topology behavior.

criteria.description: The focused B1 matrix and workspace regression remain green after the failpoint propagation and intermediate assertions.
criteria.limitations: The complete process file was 25/25 before the final intermediate assertion; the latest exact B1 run is 16/16 and the workspace regression is green after it.

gaps: The full B2B contract remains open for the principal login/cache/MFA matrix, privileged-writer enforcement, production process fault model and distributed operational controls.
Real providers, target deployment/RLS, backup/restore/RTO-RPO, remote CI, parity, accessibility, LGPD operations and release acceptance remain open.
conditions: Keep CVG-002B2B, CVG-002 and the global ERP program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL.
